record_body:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- BluePeak evaluating Redwood Dedicated for their support automation platform (agent + summarization + retrieval augmentation).
- Primary ask: predictable throughput during weekday peaks; they’ve been burned by noisy neighbor issues on shared endpoints.
- Preferred deployment: Dedicated in customer VPC (AWS). They want Redwood-managed pool but with VPC connectivity + strict tenant isolation.

PREFERRED REGION / LATENCY
- Preferred region: us-west (Oregon) due to majority of their infra/users on US West.
- Latency target (app-level): p95 end-to-end < 1.8s for “agent response” flows; streaming acceptable as long as first token < 500ms.
- They asked if we can keep inference in-region only (no cross-region spillover unless explicitly opted-in).

WORKLOAD SHAPE (POC ASSUMPTIONS)
- 2 primary routes:
  1) Chat/agent responses with tool use; mostly 1-3 turns, but can hit long prompts.
  2) Summarization of ticket threads (long context, bursty).
- Traffic pattern:
  - Baseline: ~10-20 RPS sustained during business hours.
  - Peaks: 60-90 RPS for ~10-20 min during incident spikes / major customer rollouts.
  - Concurrency sensitivity: they care about queueing and tail latency more than raw average.

MODEL + VERSION CONSTRAINTS
- Model preference for POC: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct (or equivalent quality tier).
- Hard requirements:
  - Must pin model + version (no silent upgrades).
  - Context: needs 16k for summarization route (they currently truncate aggressively and want to stop doing that).
  - Streaming: required for chat route.
- Nice-to-have:
  - Fallback model option when they exceed capacity (lower-cost smaller model OK) but only if it’s explicit and observable.

THROUGHPUT / SLO QUESTIONS (CUSTOMER VERBATIMS)
- “We don’t need infinite burst, but we do need a floor that doesn’t collapse when you’re busy.”
- Asked how throughput is measured for streaming (tokens/sec vs requests/sec) and what counts as ‘served’ vs ‘queued’ time.
- Wants POC acceptance criteria tied to a measurable commitment (even if it’s a ‘POC-only target’): throughput floor + p95 latency bands.

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE NOTES
- Security posture: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML required for console access, audit logs for admin actions, and retention controls.
- Data residency: US-only for this deployment.
- KMS: prefers customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for any stored artifacts/logging.

COMMERCIAL / PACKAGING
- Strong pull toward Dedicated Plus (they want some burst + clearer escalation posture).
- Budget sensitivity: they will compare against self-hosted vLLM cost, but acknowledge ops burden; they want Redwood’s predictable performance + reduced oncall.
- Procurement path: security review first, then POC SOW / order form, then MSA if POC hits targets.

RECENT ACTIVITY TIMELINE
- 2025-03-28: Inbound via website → routed to sales (Dedicated interest).
- 2025-04-02: POC scoping call (Fireflies: 2025-04-02-poc-scoping-dedicated-tier-plus-bluepeak). Discussed region preference, model constraints, and candidate tier.
- 2025-04-03: Follow-up email with sizing questionnaire + request for sample prompts / traffic traces (thread: 20250403-bluepeak-poc-scope-and-sizing-followups).
- 2025-04-08: SE sync with BluePeak eng lead to confirm 16k context requirement and streaming + tool-calling behavior.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Confirm exact request mix split between chat vs summarization at peak; current numbers are rough estimates.
- Confirm max output tokens per route (they mentioned 300-800 typical but occasional 2k+).
- Confirm whether embeddings/reranking will be in scope for POC (they said “maybe next quarter”).
- Confirm if they require multi-AZ HA for POC or acceptable to start single-AZ with defined failover behavior.

NEXT STEPS (INTERNAL)
- Simran (SE): run Redwood benchmark/sizing for Llama 3.1 70B @ 16k ctx, streaming enabled, using customer-provided prompt distribution.
- Irene/Vanessa (Infra/Fleet): validate us-west shape availability + lead time for a Plus-appropriate shape; provide 2 options (faster start vs ideal perf).
- Lauren (PM Dedicated): provide customer-friendly throughput SLO wording suitable for POC acceptance criteria (non-contractual or POC addendum language).

NEXT STEPS (CUSTOMER)
- BluePeak to send:
  - 50-100 representative prompts (chat + summarization)
  - Expected max context and output token caps per route
  - Desired POC duration + go-live date target
- Schedule benchmark review + proposal review next week; if sizing is acceptable, move to security questionnaire + draft order form.
